in_hebrew.name: Hodges
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hodges הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English ‘hod’ meaning ‘god’ and ‘gast’ meaning ‘healer’ or ‘guest’. The name Hodges was used for a person believed to be favored by God and called upon to heal or provide hospitality.

in_greek.name: Hodges
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει God's healer
in_greek.long_meaning: Hodges είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Old English ‘hod’ meaning ‘god’ and ‘gast’ meaning ‘healer’ or ‘guest’. The name Hodges was used for a person believed to be favored by God and called upon to heal or provide hospitality.

in_latin.name: Hodges
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat God's healer
in_latin.long_meaning: Hodges est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from Old English ‘hod’ meaning ‘god’ and ‘gast’ meaning ‘healer’ or ‘guest’. The name Hodges was used for a person believed to be favored by God and called upon to heal or provide hospitality.
